CREATE TABLE commerce.package_selectable_product (package_selectable_product_id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),package_profile_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES commerce.package_profile_version(package_profile_version_id),product_rule_profile_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES commerce.product_rule_profile(product_rule_profile_id),enabled_from timestamptz(6) NOT NULL,enabled_to timestamptz(6),min_qty integer,max_qty integer,selection_increment integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,sort_order integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',created_at timestamptz(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),UNIQUE(package_profile_version_id,product_rule_profile_id),CHECK(enabled_to IS NULL OR enabled_to>enabled_from),CHECK(min_qty IS NULL OR min_qty>=0),CHECK(max_qty IS NULL OR max_qty>0),CHECK(min_qty IS NULL OR max_qty IS NULL OR max_qty>=min_qty),CHECK(selection_increment>0));

CREATE FUNCTION commerce.ucell_package_version_guard() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN IF OLD.status<>'DRAFT' AND (NEW.display_name,NEW.currency,NEW.price_amount,NEW.selectable_product_quantity,NEW.selection_mode,NEW.membership_effect,NEW.qualification_effect,NEW.active_duration_unit,NEW.active_duration_value,NEW.target_qualification_required,NEW.member_eligibility_policy_ref,NEW.recognition_config_ref,NEW.config_hash) IS DISTINCT FROM (OLD.display_name,OLD.currency,OLD.price_amount,OLD.selectable_product_quantity,OLD.selection_mode,OLD.membership_effect,OLD.qualification_effect,OLD.active_duration_unit,OLD.active_duration_value,OLD.target_qualification_required,OLD.member_eligibility_policy_ref,OLD.recognition_config_ref,OLD.config_hash) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'published package configuration is immutable'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $$;
